faqs.question: Find a Book Fair Near You!
faqs.answer: Want to host or attend an Ignatius Book Fair? Visit ignatiusbookfairs.com to fill out an inquiry form today!

faqs.question: What’s the process if I want to host a book fair?
faqs.answer: To host a book fair, please complete an inquiry form. You will then be contacted by a Book Fair Pro who will provide more information and answer any questions you have.

faqs.question: Why did Ave Maria University and Ignatius Press start book fairs?
faqs.answer: Ave Maria University and Ignatius Press have launched book fairs to offer a refreshing, high-quality alternative to other nationally known book fairs. Our goal is to provide children with access to literature that can shape their minds and enrich their lives in meaningful and lasting ways.

faqs.question: Where can a fair be hosted?
faqs.answer: Ignatius Book Fairs are now available for schools across the continental United States! If you are interested in hosting a book fair, please fill out an inquiry form, tell us more about your school, and book an appointment. One of our dedicated Book Fair Pros will reach out to you to determine if your school is a fit for this incredible opportunity.

faqs.question: Where can a book fair be hosted?
faqs.answer: Ignatius Book Fairs are now available for schools across the continental United States! If you are interested in hosting a book fair, please fill out an inquiry form, tell us more about your school, and book an appointment. One of our dedicated Book Fair Pros will reach out to you to determine if your school is a fit for this incredible opportunity.

faqs.question: Are your book fairs in-person?
faqs.answer: Yes! We are thrilled to offer a full-service, in-person book fair experience that will captivate the hearts and minds of children, parents, and teachers alike.

faqs.question: Do you have a minimum book fair sales requirement?
faqs.answer: We do not have a set minimum for book fair sales, as we carefully select schools that are the perfect fit for an engaging in-person book fair.

faqs.question: Why did Ave Maria and Ignatius Press start a book fair service?
faqs.answer: Ave Maria University and Ignatius Press have launched book fairs to offer a refreshing, high-quality alternative to other nationally known book fairs. Our goal is to provide children with access to literature that can shape their minds and enrich their lives in meaningful and lasting ways.

faqs.question: Do the Ignatius Book Fairs offer any rewards for schools?
faqs.answer: The Ignatius Book Fairs offer 20% in Ave Dollars or 10% cash back on the total of your sales (excluding tax). For book fairs that sell $6,000 or more, we will increase this offer to 40% in Ave Dollars or 20% cash back.

faqs.question: Do you offer seasonal titles?
faqs.answer: We offer age-appropriate seasonal books —perfect for the holiday seasons.

faqs.question: What if we’ve never hosted a book fair before?
faqs.answer: First book fair? No problem! Our experienced staff will help you along the way. After signing a contract, we will send you a document called “Your Guide to Hosting a Successful Ignatius Book Fair,” which will explain in detail all our tips, tricks, and suggestions to help you plan a fantastic event. We will also break this document down into bite-sized nuggets that will arrive via email at strategic intervals to give you time to implement these tips before moving on. Plan to join us for a 3-part workshop series to help guarantee your success, particularly for first-timers. This is a live, interactive series with a short presentation, and time for questions and answers. We will cover all aspects of how to plan, host and close a successful fair.

faqs.question: How do we handle processing payments?
faqs.answer: Customers can conveniently pay using their preferred method—card, cash, or check. To ensure a seamless experience, we’ll provide you with high-quality point-of-sale devices along with comprehensive training to help you use them with ease.

faqs.question: How do you redeem your Ave Dollars balance?
faqs.answer: Any Ave Dollars balance can be redeemed on the website.

faqs.question: How does the e-Wallet work?
faqs.answer: When this feature is available, all you have to do is find your school’s book fair to sign up and add funds. Then just share the link with friends and family, who can do the same. The remaining balance after the fair will become a gift card to shop online with Ignatius Book Fairs.

faqs.question: Where can a fair be hosted?
faqs.answer: Ignatius Book Fairs are now available for schools and parishes across the continental United States! If you are interested in hosting a book fair, please fill out an inquiry form and tell us more about your school or parish. One of our dedicated Book Fair Pros will reach out to you to determine if your school or parish is a fit for this incredible opportunity.

faqs.question: Why did Ave Maria and Ignatius Press start a book fair service?
faqs.answer: Ave Maria University and Ignatius Press have launched book fairs to offer an unparalleled Catholic alternative to other nationally known book fairs. Our goal is to ensure that children have access to literature that can shape their minds and nourish their souls in the most profound way possible.

faqs.question: Where can a book fair be hosted?
faqs.answer: Ignatius Book Fairs are now available for schools and parishes across the continental United States! If you are interested in hosting a book fair, please fill out an inquiry form and tell us more about your school or parish. One of our dedicated Book Fair Pros will reach out to you to determine if your school or parish is a fit for this incredible opportunity.

faqs.question: But you will have Catholic books, right?
faqs.answer:
Yes! For our Catholic schools, we include a carefully curated selection of Catholic books—stories about the saints, Bible stories, and books that explain the faith in an engaging and age-appropriate way. Many of these titles are co-published by Magnificat and Ignatius Press, including beloved books by Tomie dePaola. We also feature titles from respected Catholic publishers including the Augustine Institute and Bethlehem Books among many others.

For schools that request a nonreligious selection—such as public charter schools—we tailor the collection accordingly. No matter the school setting, all books are chosen to be wholesome, enriching, and aligned with the needs of the communities we serve.

faqs.question: Do you offer seasonal titles?
faqs.answer: Yes, fall book fairs include titles for Advent and Christmas, while spring fairs feature books for Easter, First Holy Communion, and Confirmation.

faqs.question: Do you send only Christian books?
faqs.answer:
No, about 70% of the books we send are wholesome, nonreligious books, such as fiction, inspiring biographies, fairytales, and classic children’s books. We also include books about sports, history, arts and crafts, and more. All these books have been fully vetted to ensure that the content is safe for children and will nourish their imaginations. We believe that children deserve to read great books!

For our public charter schools, we curate a fully nonreligious collection while maintaining the same standard of high-quality, meaningful literature.  Our goal is to offer students great books that spark curiosity, inspire imagination, and support strong character.

‍

faqs.question: Do you have a minimum book fair sales requirement?
faqs.answer: We do not have a set minimum for book fair sales, as we carefully select schools and parishes that are the perfect fit for an engaging in-person book fair.

faqs.question: How much does a virtual book fair cost?
faqs.answer: We offer different options to suit your needs. If you have never hosted a book fair with Ignatius, we have 2 different boxes of books that you can order during the sign-up process so that you have a wonderful selection of our best sellers in order to use as display items and for advertising. You can choose either Catholic/religious book selections, or a mix of secular and religious books. The cost of the box you choose is $175 and the books you receive are valued at $300. Payment must be received within 15 days of signing the contract. For those who have hosted a fair with Ignatius Book Fairs before, we also offer an option without a starter box of books.

faqs.question: Can we shop for additional books from your website at an in-person book fair?
faqs.answer: Yes, our website offers an extensive collection of hundreds of more books, with new additions being made regularly.  All these books are conveniently available with free shipping to your school during our book fairs. And your school earns Ave dollars for all online purchases.

faqs.question: What if my school or parish is too small for an in-person book fair?
faqs.answer:
Ignatius Book Fairs  offers a virtual book fair. These are ideal for smaller schools. This event requires much less volunteer time and effort to organize. This option is available to larger schools too if they don’t want to host a full onsite book fair.

Is there a minimum sales requirement?

We ask that you feel confident that you have enough community support to generate at least $1000 in sales, although there is no minimum requirement.

How much does a Virtual Book Fair cost?

The cost is $175, which includes all the books, supplies, and customer support you need for a successful event. Payment must be received within 15 days of signing the contract.

What do you send us?

One week before your virtual fair begins, each organization will be sent an official virtual book fair kit. The kit will include 50 book fair flyers, 50 bookmarks, and the selection of our most popular, best-selling books you opted to receive. You may keep these books OR re-sell them at list price after your virtual book fair concludes.

How are books purchased?

All the shopping is done entirely on our website, store.ignatiusbookfairs.com and payment is by credit card. Customers simply create an online account, select your school, and start shopping!

NOTE: After your online book fair ends, if you choose to re-sell the sample books, your organization is responsible for accepting payment via check, cash, FACTS, etc.

Do you offer rewards for our organization?

Yes! Your organization will earn “Ave Dollars” which can be redeemed on our website to buy books. We offer 30% of all online sales (excluding tax) in Ave Dollars if your sales exceed $3,000. Here's an example of what you can earn:

30% Ave Dollars 

$1000 earns $300 Ave Dollars

$2000 earns $600 Ave Dollars 

$3000 earns $900 Ave Dollars 

Over $3000 earns $900 + $75 in Surprise Bonus Books  

How long will our online book fair last?

The online book fair will last 7 days. Remember, you will need a plan to promote shopping before, during, and after the event. Books ordered during the event will have the option to be held and sent to your organization with FREE shipping. Your organization is responsible for distributing these books.

What work is required from our organization?

Your main role will be to advertise your event using all the communications your organization sends out: newsletters, social media posts, parish bulletin, in the official calendar, etc. It’s best practice to advertise often leading up to the fair, then each day during the fair. To make this easy, we provide a comprehensive set of advertising resources. If your community doesn’t know about the fair, or forgets that it is happening, they won’t order! Advertising ideas will be talked about during our live workshop for virtual fairs. Please plan to sign up to attend when you receive the invitation. You will be sent the recording even if you were not able to make it to the session.

How do we advertise?

We will send you a digital kit with social media graphics, a wish list, a digital catalog and instructions on how to use them. We will also be talking a lot about advertising during our live workshop, which is built especially for our virtual fair coordinators.

What do we do after the online book fair ends?

We will notify you about your total online sales and add the Ave Dollars to your account, so you can start using the rewards you have earned!

How do we schedule a “Virtual Book Fair”?

Contact a Book Fair Pro

faqs.question: Who is on your team?
faqs.answer: Our Ignatius Book Fairs team is truly exceptional! Guided by seasoned experts from Ave Maria University and Ignatius Press, our Operations Team comprises individuals with vast experience in both Catholic schools and book fairs. Additionally, we have enthusiastic student interns from Ave Maria University lending their support. We cannot wait to connect with you!

faqs.question: Do you have a mascot?
faqs.answer: We are thrilled to unveil our new mascot, Loupio, the beloved protagonist of the widely acclaimed comic book series The Adventures of Loupio! Keep an eye out for Loupio as he makes his appearance on our website, social media platforms, and during our exciting book fairs.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: Our main office is located in the beautiful town of Ave Maria, Florida.

faqs.question: What’s the process if I want to host a book fair?
faqs.answer: To host a book fair, please complete an inquiry form. You will then be contacted by a Book Fair Pro who will provide more information and answer any questions you have.

faqs.question: How long should my fair run?
faqs.answer: Based on the size and setup of your school or parish, we suggest a duration of five to seven days for your book fair. Our experienced Book Fair Pros will assist you in determining the optimal length of time for your event.

faqs.question: Is there a cost to hosting a book fair?
faqs.answer:
Hosting an Ignatius Book Fair comes at no cost to you outside of time and talent. We will provide you with a comprehensive package including all the books, payment devices, eye-catching advertising aids, beautifully designed marketing materials, sturdy book stands, and just about everything you will need to ensure the success of your book fair.

VIRTUAL FAIRS
We have various options for those interested in hosting a virtual fair. Your book fair professional will go over options. Some may have a small cost if you would like a box of starter books to display during the fair. These books will be yours to keep.

faqs.question: How many books do you send to a book fair?
faqs.answer: The number of titles your fair receives will be based on a number of factors such as school size, previous sales, and your preferences. Our book fair pros will help you with this. All organizations will  be given the opportunity to make adjustments during our customization process, which happens approximately 60-90 days before your fair begins.

faqs.question: What ages does the book fair cater to?
faqs.answer: The Ignatius Book Fair provides books for children in grades K-8, including picture books, comic books, early readers, elementary and middle school books. We do include one table of books for "Older Teens 16+ and Adults" so the whole family can pick up a book at our fairs!

faqs.question: What are Ave Dollars?
faqs.answer: This is virtual money that can be spent at the end of your book fair in-person, over the payment device, or on our website so that you can buy more books for your libraries, classrooms, or other groups, clubs and organizational needs.

faqs.question: What happens if we have an unexpected problem during a book fair?
faqs.answer: Your Book Fair Manager will be available should any problems arise during a book fair. We are here to help!

faqs.question: What if I need to cancel, extend, delay, or change the dates of my book fair?
faqs.answer: If you need to cancel, extend, delay, or change book fair dates, please contact your Book Fair Pro as soon as possible. In unexpected cases, the school may be responsible for reimbursing shipping and/or marketing expenses.

We will also break this document down into bite-sized nuggets that will arrive via email at strategic intervals to give you time to implement these tips before moving on. Plan to join us for a 3-part workshop series to help guarantee your success, particularly for first-timers. This is a live, interactive series with a short presentation, and time for questions and answers. We will cover all aspects of how to plan, host and close a successful fair.

faqs.question: Do you have my dates available?
faqs.answer:
The best way to secure your ideal book fair dates is to reach out as soon as possible. We cannot hold dates until you receive a contract, so booking early and signing the contract within three business days of receiving it is the best way to secure your dates.

‍

faqs.question: How are book fair materials shipped and returned?
faqs.answer: All book fair materials are shipped directly to your location from our state-of-the-art warehouse in Illinois. Once your fair is complete, simply repack any remaining merchandise using the same boxes and packing materials they arrived in. Keep the posters, tablecloths, flyers and bookmarks. Let us know how many boxes you're returning, and we'll schedule a pickup for you. It's a smooth, hassle-free process—so you can focus on celebrating a successful fair!

faqs.question: Can I see the list of books that is sent to the Ignatius Book Fairs?
faqs.answer:
Our full book fair list is proprietary, but we’re happy to share a customized preview with schools and organizations after learning more about your goals and needs. In the meantime, you're welcome to browse our online store to get a sense of our high-quality, mission-aligned titles.

Our fairs feature a curated selection of both faith-based and wholesome, secular books, carefully chosen to align with the values of the communities we serve.

blogs.title: 5 Books from Ignatius Book Fairs to Read with Your Kids This Lent
blogs.content:
Discover wholesome and enriching literature at Ignatius Book Fairs, with books designed to enhance your family's faith journey. Explore hundreds of inspiring tales and timeless lessons, carefully curated to deepen your child's spiritual understanding during this sacred season. Below are five books to read with your children this Lent:

According to St. Luke | A New Catholic Title from Ignatius Book Fairs (Ages 7 and up)

The Life of Jesus—According to St. Luke provides additional descriptions of events, such as the Jewish Passover, to aid in your child’s understanding of the Lenten season. Keep your eye out for this title at the next Ignatius Book Fair or shop online at ‍

The Illustrated Miracles of Jesus for Children | A Kid-Friendly Book Fair Favorite We have discovered that younger readers love Ignatius Book Fairs for the wide variety of engaging illustrations. If you’re looking for a book for younger children, check out Jean-Francois Kieffer’s Book Fair Tip: Check out more illustrated books by Jean-Francois Kieffer at the next Ignatius Book Fair, such as

Trouble with Lent | A Catholic Lenten FavoriteFor a fictional novel to read this Lent, look for series. Published by the Augustine Institute,

The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe | A Christian Classic (Age 7 and up)

The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe is also the perfect Lenten book as it details the sacrifice of the Great Lion, Aslan. Following the adventures of Peter, Edmund, Susan, and Lucy in the land of Narnia, this novel contrasts the enslaving nature of sin with freedom of sacrificial love. The Christ-like figure of Aslan prepares readers for the sacrifice of Jesus on Good Friday and his Resurrection on Easter Sunday.  

The Lion, The Witch, and The Wardrobe has inspired countless readers over the last seven decades, and it is sure to captivate your child as well. For more wholesome fiction with a Christian twist visit the next Ignatius Book Fair!

Comic Style | Find the Perfect Bible at Ignatius Book Fairs (ages 7 and up)

The Illustrated Bible for Children is a fun and engaging way to teach your little ones about salvation history. Work through the Bible with your child this Lent, beginning with the creation of the world, through the Resurrection of Christ, and ending with Paul’s journey to Rome. This book is a wonderful introduction to the Catholic faith and a great way to get your child excited about the Lenten season!

blogs.content:

by Juliette Levivier | A Beloved Catholic Saint

Francis: The Poor Man of Assisi by Juliette Levivier is a compelling biography about the life and legacy of St. Francis of Assisi. Levivier skillfully tells the story of St. Francis, tracing his transformation from a privileged young man to a humble servant of God. Through vivid storytelling, the book explores Francis' radical commitment to poverty, his deep love for nature and animals, and his enduring impact on Christianity. Francis: The Poor Man of Assisi is a captivating portrayal of a saint whose life continues to inspire and challenge readers to live lives of faith and service.

‍

    This simple and durable illustrated missal allows a young child to follow the prayers and actions of the Holy Mass step by step! This book shows children how to act during Mass and details the parts of the Mass in easy-to-understand descriptions. ‍

    by L.E. McCullough | A Book Fair Favorite!

A Catholic Child’s Illustrated Lives of the Saints is a beautifully curated book that introduces young readers to the inspiring lives of over 65 saints! The book is thoughtfully arranged by each saint’s feast day, making it engaging and educational for children throughout the year. Each saint is accompanied by a beautiful image, short biography, and a prayer asking for their powerful intercession. Look for

by Louis de Wohl | The Crucifixion from a Different Perspective

The Spear by Louis de Wohl is a historical novel centered around the events leading up to the Crucifixion of Jesus Christ. Set in Jerusalem, the novel follows the journey of Longinus, a Roman centurion tasked with overseeing the Crucifixion. As he witnesses the events surrounding Jesus' death, Longinus experiences a profound spiritual transformation. The novel weaves together elements of historical fiction, biblical narrative, and spiritual exploration, offering readers a vivid portrayal of the Crucifixion of Jesus Christ. Through Longinus' perspective, the novel explores themes of faith, redemption, and the power of forgiveness. This book is perfect for older teens and adults!

‍

    by C.S. Lewis | A Wholesome Must-Read!

The Great Divorce by C.S. Lewis explores themes of heaven, hell, and human nature. The story follows a group of souls who take a ride from hell to the outskirts of heaven, where they are given the opportunity to either stay in heaven or return to hell. Through encounters with various celestial beings and conversations with the inhabitants of heaven, the characters grapple with their own flaws, fears, and desires. Lewis uses the fantastical setting to explore theological concepts, offering insights into the nature of sin, redemption, and the choices that shape our eternal destiny.

by Judith Bouilloc & Sara Ugolotti | Theological Lessons for Young Children

The Little Way: A Journey to the Summit of Love by Judith Bouilloc and Sara Ugolotti is a spiritual guide inspired by the life and teachings of St. Thérèse of Lisieux, also known as the Little Flower. The book explores the concept of the "Little Way," a path of spiritual growth and holiness through simple acts of love and devotion in everyday life. Drawing from Thérèse's own writings and experiences, the authors offer practical insights and reflections to help readers deepen their faith and cultivate a closer relationship with God. Through stories, prayers, and reflections, "The Little Way" invites readers to embrace humility, trust, and childlike faith as they journey toward the summit of divine love.

In this classic Catholic novel, Louis de Wohl uses his famed narrative skill to tell the story of a soldier and wealthy merchant's son who would become one of the most beloved Catholic saints.

De Wohl's narrative begins in the late 12th century, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of Assisi, Italy. The author paints a detailed picture of Francis's early life as the son of a wealthy merchant, highlighting his youthful indulgences and eventual disillusionment with material wealth. This inner turmoil leads Francis to seek a deeper meaning to his life, prompting his radical choice to renounce his possessions and live among the poor.

blogs.title: What Makes Ignatius Book Fairs a Safe Choice for Parents?
blogs.content:
Ignatius Book Fairs is dedicated to providing wholesome content for Christian families. Because of this, each title offered at an Ignatius Book Fair is specifically curated to accomplish this mission! Every book has been intentionally chosen to encourage virtue and faithfulness, while also giving children quality entertainment. Ignatius Book Fairs, by combining exceptional content with authentic Catholic faith, provides parents with literature they can trust!

    At many mainstream book fairs, children’s content is guided and shaped by modern culture. However, at Ignatius Book Fairs, all literature is grounded in the rich truth of the Catholic faith and the tradition of Christ’s Church. Although the world rejects traditional beliefs and family values, Ignatius Book Fairs continues to offer books that proclaim the truth rooted in Christ.

    “That’s our promise to parents, that anything that you find at an Ignatius Book Fair will be something that you can trust” —Rose Trabbic, IBF Director of Operations
      Ignatius Book Fairs features numerous books for families hoping to integrate the faith into their everyday life! As Parents striving to raise virtuous children deserve content they can trust! Ignatius Book Fairs is committed to offering books that won’t contradict the Christian faith, nor the importance of the family. Ultimately, Ignatius Book Fairs provides a sanctuary for Catholics seeking a nourishing, enriching, and wholesome environment to support their children through the power of literature.
blogs.summary: Ignatius Book Fairs was established to aid Catholic families in search of truthful and virtuous children’s literature. Ignatius Book Fairs offer a faith-filled solution, featuring wholesome stories centered around beauty, virtue and goodness. Here are three reasons why Ignatius Book Fairs are a safe choice for Catholic parents!

testimonials.title: Sr. Maria Guadalupe Hallee, O.P., the Principal at St. Isaac Jogues School in St. Clair Shores, MI (180 students), hosted an Ignatius Book Fair in February 2024.
testimonials.blurb: We had a great experience with Ignatius Book Fairs! We were looking for a book fair which would provide quality children's books which had been thoroughly vetted, so that we could be confident in allowing our students to browse to find something they would like. The selection of books, the variety of authors and genres, and the assistance we received from the staff of Ignatius Book Fairs led to a very successful event! We raised a generous amount of money for books for our school library, and we received very positive reviews from our librarian, our parents, our teachers, our students, and our parishioners. We are already looking forward to our next Ignatius Book Fair!

testimonials.title: Joan Hill, Librarian at St. Anthony Catholic School in Columbus, TX (175 students), hosted an Ignatius Book Fair in February 2024.
testimonials.blurb:
You gave the best advice to invite our parishioners after the weekend Masses to kick off the fair. Our CCE program is on Wednesday evenings and including them was a big hit.

Your customer service was outstanding! The books arrived in plenty of time to set up the fair in the library. Anytime that I had questions or a few issues, Ana answered me immediately and was so understanding and helpful.

Everyone was so impressed with the outstanding quality and selection of the books. It was so rewarding to see the parents excitement over books that they had read. Now they bought these books for their children. When our students joyfully bought books about our Catholic faith, we felt so blessed to be giving honor and glory to God. It was a great selection of books about the Catholic faith for children. It was more than saint books. Thank you again for providing a CATHOLIC book fair to a small Catholic school in Texas.

testimonials.title: Anna Cameron, Librarian at Our Lady of Mount Carmel Catholic School in Tempe, Arizona, (450 students), hosted an Ignatius Book Fair in February 2024.
testimonials.blurb: My community and I LOVED the book fair and would like to host it again. I am also passing along your information to a few other Catholic schools in our diocese. We loved the quality of the books! LOVED them. In particular, we loved the books the Magnificat produces. There is a huge need and interest in vibrant, imaginative children's picture books that teach virtue, our faith, and STORIES from the lives of the saints. I can't thank you enough for your work to get these books into our hands. Our school and parish thanks you!

testimonials.title: Deborah Thomas, Principal at St. Louis School in Clarksville, Maryland (575 students), hosted an Ignatius Book Fair in March 2024.
testimonials.blurb: Our Ignatius Book Fair went very well. We were very pleased with the process and books. We will be hosting a fair again next year! God bless and thank you!

testimonials.title: Dr. Lisa Rochefort, Headmaster, Naples Classical Academy
testimonials.blurb: At Naples Classical Academy, we had been waiting to find just the right kind of Book Fair that provided carefully curated wholesome fare for all ages. We found this elusive (these days) quality in Ignatius Book Fairs. The booking process was straightforward, and we were guided along the way by a dedicated Book Fair rep who supported us before, during, and after the event. Customer service was exceptional, and they provided all we needed for advertising and sales. Ave Dollars allowed us to purchase books to stock our classroom libraries with new books, and our faculty, staff, parents, and scholars all agree this event was a highlight in the academic year. We plan to host more Ignatius Book Fairs over the years.

testimonials.title: Cindy Elsom, President Aristoi Cypress PTO
testimonials.blurb: As an executive PTO board member, we have hosted several book fairs over the years. Working with Ignatius Book Fairs was a wonderful experience for us! We are a classical school and LOVE GOOD books! We have been disappointed with other vendors as they have supplied us with minimal classics for our book fair. When opening up the boxes from IBF to set up our book fair, all of our volunteers were giggling with excitement and ahhh'ing over the AMAZING selection that we received from IBF! Parents were thrilled with the wonderful selection of titles and begged us to have IBF return for our next book fair. We can't wait for our next book fair and look forward to many more with IBF in the future. Thank you so much for providing GREAT books for our young scholars and their families!
